rationale: AMLAS v1.1 explicitly distinguishes verification data from development data, directing verification teams to focus on challenging conditions and realistic failure modes rather than normal operating distributions (Note 21 and p. 25). Stage 5 (Activity 13, pp. 39–40) requires that verification activities be sufficiently independent from development and evaluate whether performance and robustness to adverse conditions/perturbations persist on unseen data. The claim is strictly framed around AMLAS methodology guidance and expressly scoped so that finite challenge verification does not imply proven generalization or operational safety approval.
evidence_locators: S-CHAL-004-R5 (AMLAS v1.1, PDF p. 26 / printed p. 25, verification-data challenge and Note 21)
S-CHAL-004-R7 (AMLAS v1.1, PDF pp. 40–41 / printed pp. 39–40, Stage 5 Objectives, Activity 13, and Note 31)
limitations: Review is restricted to the provided AMLAS v1.1 text excerpts; it does not assess physical validation results or regulatory means of compliance for specific autonomous systems.
